newer_changes_search: Searched pib.gov.in (via web search; PIB blocks direct fetch) for 2025-2026 NSAP changes. Found the Cabinet decision of 14 Oct 2026 (Release ID 2323264, confirmed by PMIndia and news coverage): NSAP continued 2026-27 to 2030-31 and renamed Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana; sub-schemes renamed; disability pension revised (Rs 375 / Rs 625, benchmark disability 40%, from birth, guidelines within three months); old-age, widow and family benefit schemes continue in existing form. The scheme already reflects this decision. Revised disability-pension guidelines were not found yet (due by about mid-January 2027). For IGNOAPS: renamed Pradhan Mantri Vridhavastha Pension Yojana; eligibility and central amounts unchanged.

findings.note: The guideline criterion is belonging to the BPL category, and para 3.1.3 says an eligible person missing from the BPL list 'should not be left out'. q.is_bpl asks about a BPL/Antyodaya ration card, so a hard confirmed fail can rule out people the guidelines say should be assessed. how_to_apply already explains this, which mitigates it.
findings.suggestion: Consider confidence 'uncertain' for the bpl rule so a 'no' gives 'check with the office'; keep the how_to_apply note.

findings.note: aadhaar and bank_account are marked mandatory, but guidelines para 5.2.12 say 'no beneficiary is denied his or her entitlements for the reason that she has no bank / Post Office account and/or Aadhaar number', and the application form (Annexe III) marks the bank account '(if available)'. ration_card is not a required document either (it appears only as an alternative age proof and as 'Ration Card No.:(if available)').
findings.suggestion: Set aadhaar, bank_account and ration_card to mandatory: false, or add a note that lacking Aadhaar or a bank account is not a reason for refusal.

findings.note: The 2014 MoRD NSAP guidelines are cited from a copy on ssepd.odisha.gov.in (an official state site), not nsap.dord.gov.in. The document is the MoRD original and is still the operative text for old-age, widow and family benefit (Cabinet 2026: 'continue in its existing form').
findings.suggestion: If the same PDF is on nsap.dord.gov.in, cite that URL instead.

findings.note: Second person in summary/benefit ('Your state adds ...'); CONTENT_AUTHORING asks for third person (instructions in how_to_apply are fine).
findings.suggestion: 'The state adds its own amount on top.'
